target: tracker.sh reconcile-done — calls forge.sh pr-state as a subprocess; non-zero exit or output outside OPEN|MERGED|CLOSED|UNKNOWN counts as UNKNOWN
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
mkdir -p factory/specs scripts/lib
cp "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/obs.sh" scripts/lib/
cat > scripts/lib/forge.sh <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "argv=$*" >> "$STUB_LOG"
echo "ppid_is_not_self=$([[ $PPID -ne $$ ]] && echo yes || echo no)" >> "$STUB_LOG"
case "$STUB_MODE" in
  merged0) echo MERGED ;;
  merged1) echo MERGED; exit 1 ;;
  garbage) echo "MERGED but with words" ;;
  lower) echo merged ;;
  empty) : ;;
esac
STUB
chmod +x scripts/lib/forge.sh
git checkout -q -b claude/idea-x; git commit -q --allow-empty -m w; git checkout -q main
export STUB_LOG="$PWD/stub.log"
reset() { printf -- '---\nid: 001\ntitle: t\nstatus: pr-open\nbranch: claude/idea-x\npr: https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7\n---\n' > factory/specs/001-s.md; }
for m in merged1 garbage lower empty merged0; do
  reset; export STUB_MODE=$m
  bash scripts/lib/tracker.sh reconcile-done tester >/dev/null 2>&1
  echo "$m=$(sed -n 's/^status: //p' factory/specs/001-s.md | head -1)"
done
echo "invocations=$(grep -c '^argv=' stub.log 2>/dev/null)"
grep -m1 '^argv=' stub.log 2>/dev/null
grep -q 'ppid_is_not_self=yes' stub.log 2>/dev/null && echo subprocess=yes
[[ -x "$F" ]] || FX_MISSING=127
fx_done
